subject.title: fix: antml:/mm: namespaced tool-call XML leaks into chat replies (#97750)

question: Should OpenClaw accept guarded promotion of standalone antml/mm attribute-dialect XML text into executable tool calls, and ship the additive preserveCodeRegions Plugin SDK option?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but the durable choice is whether degraded assistant text may be repaired into tool execution and whether the new SDK mode should become public API.

options.title: Approve Guarded Promotion
options.body: Accept the execution-boundary change with standalone parsing, allowed-tool-name gating, namespace allow-listing, strict SDK default, and code-aware internal delivery tests, then merge after normal maintainer review.

options.title: Require Strip-Only Behavior
options.body: Keep sanitizing leaked XML from user-visible text but reject automatic promotion back into executable tool calls until a narrower execution policy is approved.

options.title: Keep SDK Mode Internal
options.body: Ask the author to avoid exporting the new SDK option unless maintainers explicitly want that plugin API surface now.

recommendation.title: Approve Guarded Promotion
recommendation.body: Accept the execution-boundary change with standalone parsing, allowed-tool-name gating, namespace allow-listing, strict SDK default, and code-aware internal delivery tests, then merge after normal maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across provider-stream SDK seams, sanitizer refactors, and public plugin API boundaries relevant to this choice.
